prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes in Houston, Texas. Injury: knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1207; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was changing lanes on a busy Houston highway when a vehicle in the lane I was moving into sideswiped the rear quarter of my car. The impact pushed me toward the median, and I had to fight the steering wheel to bring the car under control. I pulled onto the shoulder and called for help right away. My right knee struck the dashboard during the collision, and it has been swollen and painful since. I have given the same account of what happened to the officer at the scene, to the adjuster, and to my doctor, and I have nothing to add or change. I am the named driver on this policy and I was operating my own vehicle with the owner's permission at the time of the accident.
